name: Attio
one_liner: Attio is a CRM and relationship-intelligence platform for sales and go-to-market teams, offering a REST API, App SDK, and hosted MCP server for programmatic workspace access.
needs_human_reasons: pass1/pass2 disagree on access (admin_approval vs paid_plan)

evidence.quote: Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification.
We also support HTTP Basic Authentication, where the username is the token and the password is left blank.
you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps
Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server
Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required.

notes: Attio's REST API supports OAuth2 (multi-workspace apps) or single-workspace API keys generated in Workspace Settings > Developers, both used as Bearer tokens (Basic Auth also supported). API/webhook access is gated behind paid plans (Plus/Pro/Enterprise) — the Free plan does not include it, so credentials aren't obtainable on a free tier, hence paid_plan/yellow rather than green. Attio also publishes an official hosted MCP server (mcp.attio.com) authenticated via OAuth login to the user's Attio account, in addition to several community MCP servers (kesslerio/attio-mcp-server etc.) seen in the registry hints. API breadth estimated as medium based on object/record/list/attribute/note/task/webhook endpoint surface and third-party wrappers (e.g. Composio) exposing ~109 tools built on it; exact endpoint count not verified.
